name: Little Robots
description: Tiny and his Little Robot friends create their own world from the scrapheap on which they find themselves abandoned.

videos.title: Sound of Music
videos.overview: Convinced by Tiny that it'll be impossible play five instruments all by herself, Noisy decides to form a band, but Sporty is horrified to discover that Noisy wants him to be the singer.

videos.title: The Hiccalots
videos.overview: Sporty bumps into Noisy who gets a bad case of robotic hiccups. Everyone tries different ways to cure her.

videos.title: A Friend for Teddy
videos.overview: Rusty is embarrassed when she discovers Spotty's secret affection for her pink fluffy slippers.

videos.title: Robot Race Day
videos.overview: The Little Robots hold a sports day.

videos.title: Knock Knock
videos.overview: Spotty and Scary keep getting confused about which home belongs to which of the Sparky twins, so the twins decide to put shiny things on their doors to identify which is which.

videos.title: Spotty's Clean Machine
videos.overview: Wanting to get all their stuff clean, Spotty tries out Stretchy's new cleaning machine, but it goes out of control.

videos.title: One Hundred
videos.overview: When their artificial moon breaks, Tiny enlists the help of the other robots to make a new one.

videos.title: Stretchy in a Twist
videos.overview: Trying to do too many things at once, Stretchy gets his long neck stuck in a knot.

videos.title: Stripy on the Ball
videos.overview: Stripy makes a new ball, but the Sparky Twins steal it.They get trapped and the other robots rescue them.

videos.title: Scary, Scary
videos.overview: Scary has been trying to frighten the little robots, but is unsuccessful until he accidentally gets covered in his magnetic props.

videos.title: Hole in the Sky
videos.overview: Rusty is terrified on finding a hole in the sky above her home.

videos.title: Noisy's New Song
videos.overview: When the hatch in Stretchy's junkyard is jammed, Noisy comes to the rescue - by singing a lullaby.

videos.title: A Bit of Give and Take
videos.overview: Tiny needs some help with the Nut and Bolt Tree.

videos.title: Barking Mad
videos.overview: Messy barks all night at a nonexistent cat, keeping Stretchy awake and ending up losing his bark.

videos.title: Tiny Who?
videos.overview: Spotty offers the Sparky Twins an opportunity for mischief.

videos.title: The Big Bounce
videos.overview: Rusty is looking forward to her bouncing lesson with Sporty.

videos.title: Reach for the Sky
videos.overview: Sporty envies the Robobirds' ability to fly, and Stretchy has problems with some magnets.

videos.title: Spotty Rules
videos.overview: Spotty decides that the Little Robots should be in her club and follow her commands.

videos.title: Not a Drum Was Heard
videos.overview: Spotty cannot bear the din when Noisy practices on his drums and sneaks the drum away.

videos.title: Spotty's Big Idea
videos.overview: Spotty decides she wants to be an artist and builds a huge sculpture from junk.

videos.title: Seeing Double
videos.overview: Tiny builds a replica of himself to keep the Robobirds away from Stripy's plants. Sporty and Messy are horrified when they break 'Tiny' into pieces while playing ball.

videos.title: The Box of Shocks
videos.overview: Noisy is very taken with a box that comes down Stretchy's chute.

videos.title: By Myself
videos.overview: Stripy wants to go fishing on his own, but the other Little Robots want to come along.

videos.title: Sweet Dreams, Scary
videos.overview: Scary is so tired, he falls asleep in the middle of one of his magic tricks.

videos.title: United
videos.overview: Stripy needs to borrow some oil from Tiny.

videos.title: Spotlight on Strechy
videos.overview: Stretchy takes it to heart when the Sparky Twins tell him that he's no fun, and makes a fool of himself in a desperate attempt to change their minds.

videos.title: Where's Teddy?
videos.overview: Stripy loses Teddy and everyone joins in the search.

videos.title: Red Alert
videos.overview: An intruder has broken into the Little Robot world, but it is only Stretchy's latest invention.

videos.title: The Waker-Upper
videos.overview: Tiny oversleeps and doesn't turn the day on, so Stretchy makes him a waker-upper machine.

videos.title: Too Speedy Sporty
videos.overview: Sporty is just too fast and causes havoc with his high speeds.

videos.title: Bump in the Night
videos.overview: The Sparky Twins ask Scary if they can borrow Flappy to be in their new show.

videos.title: The Wind Machine
videos.overview: Tiny makes a wind machine so that Scary's bunting will flutter.

videos.title: The Odd Couple
videos.overview: Noisy stays with Stripy while his house is being fixed after an accident.

videos.title: Good Sport Sporty
videos.overview: Sporty finishes his chores first, but ends up snowed under when everyone asks him for help finishing theirs.

videos.title: Metal Makes Us Special
videos.overview: The Robots celebrate what they are made of with a procession of floats.

videos.title: Look Out Spotty
videos.overview: Spotty becomes obsessed with health and safety concerns.

videos.title: Down Tools Tiny
videos.overview: Tiny feels unappreciated, so he decides to let the others sort out their own problems.

videos.title: Screw Loose Spotty
videos.overview: When Spotty takes a tumble, she loosens a screw and goes into demolition mode.

videos.title: Who Did That?
videos.overview: The Sparkies find a box of bits that they turn into vehicles with joysticks.

videos.title: Wheels Are Fun
videos.overview: Tiny's new invention causes much excitement amongst the Little Robots.

videos.title: Teddy's Big Day Out
videos.overview: Tiny doesn't want to worry Stripy by telling him his bear is missing.

videos.title: Under the Stars
videos.overview: Spotty persuades Rusty to head off into the Wasteland with her to sleep out under the stars.

videos.title: Fly Me to the Moon
videos.overview: Scary decides he wants to be more like Flappy the Bat, so tries to fly to the moon.

videos.title: Sparkle Day
videos.overview: It's Sparkle Day - a special event. Everyone loves it except Rusty, who is too shy to sparkle.

videos.title: The Show Must Go On
videos.overview: Scary wants to put on a show and goes on a search for a glamorous assistant.

videos.title: On Balance
videos.overview: Tiny's metal measurer is used as a seesaw by the Sparky twins, much to Spotty's distress.

videos.title: Noisy Knows Noise
videos.overview: Messy hits his head and all of a sudden starts to moo, baa and miaow instead of barking. Meanwhile, Noisy challenges Scary to come up with a noise she doesn't know though she warns him she knows every noise there is.

videos.title: Small Shiny Metal Things
videos.overview: Rusty's collection of small shiny metal things is disappearing piece by piece.

videos.title: Swings and Roundabouts
videos.overview: Scary wants the other little robots to entertain him for a change.

videos.title: Amazing Scary
videos.overview: Scary builds a maze and the Little Robots can't wait to have a go at exploring it.

videos.title: Repeat After Me
videos.overview: Stripy speeds up but the others decide he was better being slow.

videos.title: Stripy's Dancing Flowers
videos.overview: The Sparky Twins are up to their usual tricks, causing mayhem and chaos.

videos.title: Sporty the Hero
videos.overview: Rusty gives Sporty a medal, saying he is her hero. Sporty would like to be a hero but isn't sure how.

videos.title: Strechy's Yard Guard
videos.overview: Stretchy's good intentions backfire when his yard guard turns on him.

videos.title: The Bedtime Badbot
videos.overview: Two robots dress up as electronic bogeyman the Bedtime Badbot, after Scary tells them about it.

videos.title: Not Just Junk
videos.overview: Stretchy gives away all his junk. Unsurprisingly, he then misses it.

videos.title: Sporty Makes a Mess
videos.overview: Sporty overdoes things and makes a real mess.

videos.title: The Nut and Bolt Cracker Suite
videos.overview: Spotty gets a bad case of stage fright.

videos.title: The Sparkie's Big Night Out
videos.overview: The Sparky twins have a great plan to make up for all the mischief they have caused.

videos.title: Tunnel Trouble
videos.overview: The Sparky twins are up to their usual tricks.

videos.title: Beautiful and New
videos.overview: Noisy is having a trouble finding a new noise.

videos.title: Stargazing
videos.overview: Tiny loves stargazing and decides he would rather have longer nights and shorter days.

videos.title: Water Water Everywhere
videos.overview: Water comes through the roof of Little Robot world and the Little Robots escape in an ark.

videos.title: The Scaredy Bot Goes Boing
videos.overview: Scary wants to frighten some Little Robots with his new ride. Tiny pretends to be scared.

videos.title: Tingaling Thing
videos.overview: It is Robofest time, so the robots get their dancing shoes on.
